obligations.source_text: Photorealistic patient-eye-level medium close-up of an unmistakably adult fictional nurse whose face preserves the reference woman's pale oval proportions, ash-blonde hair, gray eyes, and natural human facial geometry. She stands slightly inside the same adult patient's personal space in a quiet private treatment room. A small tender asymmetric smile and faint cheek flush show genuine devotion to that same patient, while her eyes remain precisely target-locked yet unnervingly lifeless: dim physically coherent catchlights, flattened low-contrast irises, slightly raised upper lids, and faint lower-lid tension. Her gaze, head, and torso converge on the patient as she calmly holds a capped syringe low in one hand and slides the patient's call button just beyond reach with the other; the taut cable and clear gap show that the patient's option has already narrowed. Warm face light meets restrained clinical falloff, realistic skin and eye moisture, natural hands, intimate 50mm photography. The affectionate mouth, deadened eyes, controlling gesture, and visible consequence coexist in the same instant.
